t: You're looking at a statue of Elizabeth the First, at the church of St Dunstan-in-the-West on Fleet Street. Elizabeth was Queen of England and Ireland from 1558 until her death in 1603. She was the last and longest reigning monarch of the House of Tudor. Her eventful reign, and its effect on history and culture, gave its name to the Elizabethan era. Here she is shown in stone, looking out over the street.
